title: 第9章 沈轩-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    这边韩小汐还没睡醒，另一边，沈珩已经在斯蒂芬的鬼斧神工下，藏起了有些重的黑眼圈，和一众政要一起参加了江市非遗文化节的开幕仪式。

    沈珩作为江市非遗文化的推广大使，和领导们一起上台剪彩。

    当一个三百六十度无死角的完美偶像。

    开幕式结束，还要立即去当地的电视台录制非遗推广片，一直到晚上参加完晚宴才能返程。

    “大炜，你说老板这么拼，图的是什么？”斯蒂芬和郭炜在后台看着光鲜亮丽的活动现场。

    “图养你。”郭炜没好气地白了他一眼，“咱们这些人，哪个不是靠老板吃饭的！”

    “说的也是。”斯蒂芬耸肩，“打游戏吗？给你玩一局？”

    ……

    韩小汐一直睡到大中午才醒来，匆匆忙忙吃了碗泡面就打车去了剧组。

    刘超的助理阿强带她去找美术指导老周。

    一个和于导差不多大的小老头，看了她一眼，随意说道:“小姑娘学画画的？”

    “是的，周老师。”韩小汐礼貌地回答。

    “那老于有的折腾你了。”老周回给她一个深表同情的眼神，“我这边主要是负责置景和道具，基本上人手够用，你就跟着老于盯片场吧。”

    “好的，周老师。”

    在韩小汐的印象中，一般大剧组的美术指导都是艺术家一样的细节控，这位周老师反倒像是不拘小节的写意大师。

    还真的挺有意思。

    片场正在拍摄的是执行导演负责的B组，于导今天并不在，估计也是熬了大夜，需要休息。

    似乎那位今天还有其他工作……

    韩小汐思绪不由自主地想到了沈珩。

    又猛地收回，好端端的操心他做什么!

    于导不在，韩小汐临时被塞在了现场道具组，一个下午就写了三封道具信，顺带帮刘超写了一份通告单，就没有然后了。

    惬意地躲在角落里晒太阳。

    小手机里贪吃蛇玩得正嗨，一道身影很没形象的一屁股坐在她身边。

    不小心碰到了韩小汐的胳膊.

    嘣——

    蛇头撞蛇身，华丽丽的“game over”。

    “抱歉。”很好听的清朗男声。

    广播剧里阳光美少男的声音！

    韩小汐眸子一亮。

    倏地抬头。

    wow！

    好一个白衣飘飘、唇红齿白的少年郎！

    好眼熟！

    “沈、沈轩！”韩小汐没经大脑喊出了声。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Han Xiaoxi has not yet woken up. On the other side, Shen Heng has already hidden the heavy dark circles under Stephen's uncanny skills and attended the opening ceremony of the Jiang City Intangible Cultural Heritage Festival with a group of dignitaries.

As the promotion ambassador of Jiang City’s intangible cultural heritage, Shen Heng went to the stage to cut the ribbon with the leaders.

Be a perfect idol with no blind spots at 360 degrees.

After the opening ceremony, you have to go to the local TV station immediately to record the intangible cultural heritage promotional video, and you can’t return until you have attended the dinner in the evening.

"Da Wei, what do you mean the boss is trying so hard for?" Stephen and Guo Wei looked at the glamorous event scene in the background.

"I'm trying to support you." Guo Wei rolled his eyes at him angrily, "None of us depend on the boss for a living!"

"That's right." Stephen shrugged, "Want to play a game? Let me play a game for you?"

……

Han Xiaoxi slept until noon before waking up. She hurriedly ate a bowl of instant noodles and took a taxi to the set.

Liu Chao’s assistant Aqiang took her to find art director Lao Zhou.

A little old man who was about the same age as Director Yu glanced at her and said casually: "Young girl learns to draw?"

"Yes, Teacher Zhou." Han Xiaoxi replied politely.

"Then Lao Yu You is tormenting you." Lao Zhou gave her a look of deep sympathy, "I am mainly responsible for setting up the scenery and props. Basically, I have enough manpower. Just follow Lao Yu and watch the set."

"Okay, Teacher Zhou."

In Han Xiaoxi’s impression, most art directors of large production crews are as detail-oriented as artists, but Teacher Zhou is like a freehand master who doesn’t stick to trivial details.

It’s really interesting.

What is being filmed on the set is Group B, which is in charge of the executive director. Director Yu is not here today. He probably stayed up late and needs to rest.

It seems that that person has other work today...

Han Xiaoxi couldn’t help but think of Shen Heng.

Then he took it back suddenly, worrying about what he was doing!

Director Yu was away, so Han Xiaoxi was temporarily assigned to the on-site props team. She wrote three props letters in one afternoon, and also helped Liu Chao write a notice, and nothing more happened.

​​Hide comfortably in the corner and bask in the sun.

小手机里贪吃蛇玩得正嗨，一道身影很没形象的一屁股坐在她身边。

He accidentally touched Han Xiaoxi’s arm.

Boom——

The snake's head hits the snake's body, a gorgeous "game over".

"Sorry." A nice, clear male voice.

The voice of the sunny boy in the radio drama!

Han Xiaoxi’s eyes lit up.

He raised his head suddenly.

Wow!

What a young man with fluttering white clothes, red lips and white teeth!

It looks so familiar!

"Shen, Shen Xuan!" Han Xiaoxi shouted without thinking.
